Dominating the upper half are massive, elongated, and irregularly shaped soap bubbles with vivid iridescent colors (pinks, greens, blues) that contrast sharply with the desaturated background. The largest bubble stretches horizontally across the frame, appearing to float above the pedestrians. A smaller, more spherical bubble is visible on the right. An orange object lies on the ground in the foreground.
